# EmpowerX3 — Longevity Wellness Center

> EmpowerX3 is a longevity wellness center in Marble Falls, TX. Gary Brandt, a longevity coach, leads a 90-day Core Program combining DNA Blueprint genetic testing, peptide therapy (via partnered licensed providers), biomarker optimization, weekly 1-on-1 coaching, and the ExoPod 10-in-1 cellular recovery system. EmpowerX3 also offers the 90-Day Gut Rebuild & Detox (digestion, energy and detox with labs and coaching), a Guided Mold Recovery program (exposure plan, labs including a mycotoxin panel, and a paced four-phase detox), and a Genetic Meal Prep service — chef-prepared whole-food meals (by Chef David) built from each client's genetic and bloodwork data. Approach: Body. Mind. Spirit. — optimizing all three simultaneously because "nothing works until everything works together."

## Education Hub: Symptom-First Guides

The Solutions Library organizes content by symptom pattern rather than diagnosis, because people search by how they feel.

- [Tired, Foggy & No One Can Tell You Why](https://empowerx3.com/education/mystery-fatigue): Guide for symptoms that follow a building — better away from home, worse upon return, worse on damp days. Explains the exposure-first sequence (certified inspection, remediation), why DIY detoxes backfire, and the four phases of Mold Recovery
- [Bloated, Crashing & Running on Caffeine](https://empowerx3.com/education/digestion-energy): Guide for the gut-energy pattern — afternoon crashes, progressive bloating, cravings, unrefreshing sleep. About 80% of the immune system sits along the gut and most serotonin is made there. Explains the three phases of the 90-Day Gut Rebuild

**Symptom articles (environmental pathway):**

- [Why Do I Feel Better When I Leave My House?](https://empowerx3.com/education/why-do-i-feel-better-when-i-leave-my-house): Symptoms that ease away from home and return with you signal the building. First step is stopping exposure, not supplements
- [Brain Fog After Water Damage: Why It Lingers](https://empowerx3.com/education/brain-fog-after-water-damage): Why symptoms outlast cleanup, and the paced recovery order: confirm exposure stopped, test (mycotoxin panel), then phased support
- [Why Did My Detox Make Me Feel Worse?](https://empowerx3.com/education/why-detox-made-me-feel-worse): Feeling worse on a detox usually means toxins are mobilized faster than the body clears them — a pacing and ordering problem, not a personal failure

**Symptom articles (gut pathway):**

- [Why Am I Bloated Every Afternoon?](https://empowerx3.com/education/why-am-i-bloated-every-afternoon): Bloating that builds through the day is a pattern driven by slowed digestion, meal pacing and gut imbalance; the fix starts with labs
- [Waking Up Tired After 8 Hours?](https://empowerx3.com/education/wake-up-tired-after-8-hours): Unrefreshing sleep connects to gut health — most serotonin is gut-made and feeds the melatonin pathway
- [You Took Probiotics and Nothing Changed. Here's Why.](https://empowerx3.com/education/why-probiotics-didnt-work): Probiotics are step three; digestion restoration and lining repair come first. Order matters more than the bottle

## Core Program (90-Day Longevity Transformation)

The Core Program starts with comprehensive data — DNA Blueprint analysis, 50+ biomarkers, hormone panels, and metabolic markers — then builds a personalized protocol from that biology rather than a template.

**What's included:**

- DNA Blueprint analysis and genetic testing
- Comprehensive biomarker and lab panel (50+ markers)
- Hormone panel, metabolic markers, and nutrient status assessment
- Peptide therapy protocol under medical supervision (Impact Health Network licensed providers)
- Personalized nutrition and supplement plan built from lab data and DNA
- Regular 1-on-1 longevity coaching (habit tracking, protocol adjustments, mindset)
- ExoPod cellular recovery sessions
- Accountability and habit-building framework
- Recovery, sleep, and stress management protocols

**How it works:**

1. **Month 1 — Data Collection & Foundation:** Baseline biomarker, hormone, metabolic, and DNA testing while establishing hydration, sleep, daily movement, and stress management habits
2. **Months 2–3 — Personalized Protocol & Peptide Therapy:** Targeted nutrition, supplement stack, lifestyle modifications, and peptide therapy under medical supervision through licensed providers
3. **Throughout — Accountability & Optimization:** Consistent coaching calls, progress monitoring, and protocol refinement

**Important:** EmpowerX3 is a lifestyle coaching and wellness optimization service, not a medical treatment. All peptides and prescription compounds are provided exclusively through licensed healthcare providers within the Impact Health Network. Coaches do not diagnose, prescribe, or treat medical conditions.

The ExoPod delivers 10 advanced cellular therapies in a single 30-minute session for $99. Recommended 2–3 sessions per week.

**Therapies in a session:**

1. **BioAlign Balance Therapy** — rotating magnetic field for nervous system reset (fight-or-flight to rest-and-digest)
2. **Oxygen Ion Air Therapy** — negative ion infusion for mental clarity and mood
3. **DeepWave Energy Therapy** — terahertz frequency for cellular communication and ATP production
4. **Photon Glow Light Therapy** — red (630–660nm) and near-infrared (850–940nm) light for mitochondrial health and collagen production
5. **Chromotherapy** — customizable ambient light for emotional and hormonal balance
6. **Resonance Pulse Therapy** — vibration wave for lymphatic drainage
7. **O3 Cleanse** — medical-grade ozone disinfection between every session
8. **Integrated Infrared Heat & Convection** — detoxifying thermal environment for weight loss and recovery

See https://empowerx3.com/tools for the complete 10-therapy sequence.

**Results timeline:** Immediate stress relief within 1–5 sessions; enhanced skin tone, reduced inflammation, and weight loss benefits within 2–4 weeks; comprehensive cellular renewal and sustainable weight management at 4–12+ weeks.

Every protocol starts with a comprehensive genetic panel revealing how the body processes nutrients, responds to stress, and builds muscle. Month one includes a plant medicine detox; then a personalized supplement stack is built from genetic data and lab results.

## Genetic Meal Prep (Chef-Prepared Meals from DNA & Bloodwork)

EmpowerX3's Genetic Meal Prep service builds a meal plan from each client's genetic testing and bloodwork data, then translates that plan into real, whole-food meals prepared by Chef David — not supplements, shakes, or generic macro charts.

**The science behind it:**

- **Methylation** is a biochemical process happening billions of times per second in the body. It drives detoxification, mood and stress regulation, DNA expression, inflammation control, and energy production. It depends on dietary folate (B9), B12, B6, and choline.
- **MTHFR gene variants** (the most well-known methylation-related variants) reduce how efficiently the body converts synthetic folic acid into its active form. People with these variants often benefit from naturally occurring folate (leafy greens, legumes, certain fruits) and foods rich in already-active B vitamins.
- Other genetic variants influence how the body handles fats, carbohydrates, caffeine, histamine, and sodium — none of which appears on a standard nutrition label.
- **Genetics + bloodwork together:** genetics reveal long-term predispositions (e.g., lower B12 conversion); bloodwork reveals current status (e.g., actually low B12). A meal plan built from both supports long-term biology and current health.

**Why genetics-based meal planning beats generic diets:** nutrient needs become individualized; food works with your biology instead of against it; root-cause patterns like fatigue, brain fog, mood swings, and sluggish detoxification become easier to address through diet.

**Methylation-supportive foods:** dark leafy greens, legumes, eggs, wild-caught salmon, beets, asparagus, avocado, and liver — matched to each client's variants and lab results.

**Contact for Genetic Meal Prep:** gary@empowerx3.com or https://empowerx3.com/contact

## Frequently Asked Questions

- **What should I wear during my ExoPod session?** Minimal clothing or swimwear; long hair should be worn up so therapies can penetrate the skin directly
- **How often should I use the ExoPod?** 2–3 times per week for significant weight loss and long-term anti-aging results
- **Is the ExoPod safe?** Yes — non-invasive, non-ionizing frequencies; the pod is sanitized between every client with medical-grade ozone
- **How much does the Core Program cost?** $4,997 for the 90-day program, including testing, coaching, and ExoPod sessions
- **Do I need to live in Marble Falls?** No — the Core Program supports remote clients; ExoPod sessions and Wolfpack hikes are in-person in the Hill Country
- **What is methylation and why does it matter?** Methylation is a biochemical process running billions of times per second that drives detoxification, mood regulation, DNA expression, inflammation control, and energy production; it depends on dietary folate, B12, B6, and choline
- **What is the MTHFR gene variant?** A common genetic variant that reduces the efficiency of converting synthetic folic acid into active folate; people with it often do better with natural folate from leafy greens, legumes, and foods rich in active B vitamins
- **What is the Genetic Meal Prep service?** EmpowerX3 builds a meal plan from your genetic and bloodwork data, then Chef David prepares the actual whole-food meals — see https://empowerx3.com/genetic-meal-prep
- **What is the Gut Rebuild?** A 90-day program focused on digestion, energy and detox: baseline labs, three phases (Remove & Defend, Repair & Repopulate, Release & Rebalance), coaching on days 1/30/60/90, and every supplement included — see https://empowerx3.com/gut-rebuild
- **What is Mold Recovery?** A ~4-month guided program for people whose fatigue, fog or symptoms followed a leak, flood or water-damaged building: exposure checklist, mycotoxin panel and labs via a nationwide medical network, and a paced four-phase detox — see https://empowerx3.com/mold-recovery
- **Do I need to live in Marble Falls?** No — the Gut Rebuild and Mold Recovery deliver locally to Lakeway, Bee Cave, Spicewood, Marble Falls and Horseshoe Bay, and ship everywhere else
- **Does EmpowerX3 diagnose or treat medical conditions?** No. EmpowerX3 provides lifestyle coaching, not medical treatment. Lab work and medical decisions are handled by licensed providers, and clients work alongside their own doctors
